verdict.rationale: treg ships an official CLI, installed via install.sh. It documents authentication through GitHub, an emailed OTP, or an invite code. `treg upload clis` publishes local CLIs as team tools, and agent install is shown via `/plugin install treg@treg`. That is only a loose analogue of publish-and-deploy: there is no evidence of staging or building a server and pushing it, and new listings are submitted as a GitHub pull request rather than through the CLI. Missing for 10: CLI build/stage of a server, a CLI push/deploy command for servers, CLI-driven install of published servers into agents, and independent corroboration.
